column2: raw data of small mammal survey captured using live traps
project phase: 1 - corresponds to the time period between 2017 and 2019. 2 - corresponds to the time period between 2021 and 2023
identification number of the sampling site where the grids with live traps  were set
identification number of the grid set in the sampling site (plot)
identification of the trap in the grid
date (DD-MM-YYYY) when the survey was performed
type of vegetation savanna, sdtf - seasonally dry tropical  forest, riparian forest, forested savanna, or forest corresponding to sdtf or riparian forest
longitude coordinate in decimal degrees, corresponding to the plot centre, missing data (NA)
latitude coordinate in decimal degrees, corresponding to the plot centre, missing data (NA)
type of live-trap used in survey - Tomarawk and Sherman live traps with bait, missing data (NA)
location where the grid was placed in the plot - ground or subcanopy, missing data (NA)
identification of capture or recapture individuals
type of plantation in the matrix - pasture (plantation), agriculture (mainly soybean in rotation with corn, sorghum or millet)

location of the grid in the landscape - core - grids were set in the core of the natural vegetation remnant, edge - grids were set in the natural vegetation remnant, matrix - grids were set in the matrix
climatic season in the Neotropics - wet (summer) or dry (winter and spring)
crop management cycle - fallow and crop_growth
individual identification number, missing data (NA)
voucher number of the UFG zoological collection, missing data (NA)
ear ring number for the capture individuals that were released, missing data (NA)
species identification
gender - male or female, missing data (NA)
